```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(gtExtras)
library(sf)
library(tmap)

tmap_mode("view")
```

```{r read-data}
#| include: false
source("_results.R")
source("_verify.R")
source("_tables.R")
source("_maps.R")
source("_statewide-map.R")
```

## Results of the four closest forecast races

```{r top-four-results}
#| column: page
featured |>
    with_provisional_outcomes() |>
    results_table("Results of the four closest forecast races",
                  show_margin_note = FALSE) |>
    cols_label(opponent = "Republican") |>
    cols_hide(columns = other_votes) |>
    tab_options(table.width = px(1035))
```

## Other notable results

### 22nd Middlesex

```{r notable-results}
#| column: page
results_table(notable, "22nd Middlesex result", show_margin_note = FALSE) |>
    cols_hide(columns = other_votes) |>
    tab_options(table.width = px(1035))
```

```{r 22nd-middlesex-results-map, fig.height=6, fig.cap=map_caption("Twenty-Second Middlesex")}
municipality_result_map("Twenty-Second Middlesex") +
    tm_view(set_view = 12)
```

## Results for all contested seats

```{r statewide-results-map, fig.cap=paste("Contested legislative seats. Use the selector to switch between House and Senate districts. Stripes indicate a party flip; dashed outlines indicate a provisional result in an uncalled race.", source_note)}
#| column: body-outset
statewide_outcome_map()
```

```{r all-results}
#| column: screen
results |>
    with_provisional_outcomes() |>
    arrange(desc(abs(signed_error)), chamber, district_display) |>
    results_table("Results of all 57 contested legislative races", full = TRUE)
```
